name: August
objective: Attendance-led renewals and upgrades; bring new clients in on a Rookie leaderboard; Mumbai's second seasonal peak.
strategy:
The Amazing Race 2.0.

Commercial job: Attendance-led renewals and upgrades; bring new clients in on a Rookie leaderboard; Mumbai's second seasonal peak.

Newcomer: Starting Gun Week (“Seven days unlimited from the day the race starts. Then 20% off.”). A Rookie leaderboard and an unlimited week make an individual race winnable for beginners.

Newcomer: Tag Team (“Friendship Day: race with a friend who's never been.”). Friendship Day and the race start on the same day; referred friends convert above paid leads.

Winback: Back on Track (“Your lane is still open. 20% off to get back in it.”). The race is the reason; the 20% is the push.

Renewal: Victory Lap (“Finish the race, unlock the podium prices.”). The race lifts attendance, attendance lifts renewals; the best prices go to the people most likely to stay.
notes:
Moment: The Amazing Race 2.0 (1–31 Aug): every client races on their own against the studio leaderboard; Rookie leaderboard for first-timers; Independence Day 'Freedom Ride' powerCycle (Sun 15 Aug).
Build: new clients 48 buyers × ₹12,000 = ₹5.8L; reactivation 36 × ₹11,468 = ₹4.1L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹3.2L; renewals ₹25.9L. First visits needed 160 vs 145 last year (1.10×); CRM leads needed 320 vs 213 last year.
